Problem_Opportunity: Low or variable supply pressure degrades shower force and coverage.
Existing_Solution_or_Source: Pressure compensation, adaptive nozzles, dual-resistance networks.
DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: Widen useful pressure window without a pump.
Proposed_Product_Response: Pressure-dependent parallel flow paths with controlled resistance.
User_Benefit: Defined spray force/coverage across a broader pressure envelope.
Evidence_Source: Knowledge Sheet MS-001; TR-001; TR-020; TR-033
Main_Uncertainty: No measured advantage over mature adaptive nozzles.

Problem_Opportunity: Shower aerosol generation may be undesirable in care/health-sensitive environments.
Existing_Solution_or_Source: Conventional outlet geometry; ventilation/disinfection/filter approaches; LAMI.
DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: Reduce aerosol at source while retaining pressure and coverage.
Proposed_Product_Response: LSR/compliant outlet geometry optimized for droplet distribution.
User_Benefit: Lower airborne particle concentration under controlled conditions.
Main_Uncertainty: Quantitative reduction, spray quality, cleaning and durability unverified.

Problem_Opportunity: Reduce cold-water waste before shower use.
Water efficiency and hygiene/aerosol control create interacting constraints.
Existing_Solution_or_Source: Pressure-compensating/fluidic shower tech; aerosol-control concepts; microbiome research.
DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: One terminal outlet controlling spray, aerosol and internal retention.
Proposed_Product_Response: Low-retention path + controlled outlet + optional purge.
User_Benefit: Maintain spray targets while reducing aerosol/residual-water metric.
Main_Uncertainty: No demonstrated advantage over separate measures.

Problem_Opportunity: Microbial persistence at shower terminal outlets.
Existing_Solution_or_Source: System disinfection, water/vapor treatment, water management.
DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: Translate microbiome-control mechanisms to fitting scale.
User_Benefit: Reduced microbial persistence/dispersal under defined tests.
Main_Uncertainty: Mechanism, safety, potable-water compliance, energy and durability.

DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: No new outcome beyond prior candidate.

Problem_Opportunity: Fine mist and non-uniform spray can reduce useful rinsing and increase airborne moisture.
Existing_Solution_or_Source: Conventional spray faces, pressure-adaptive nozzles, LAMI, US20260091399.
DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: Test large-droplet-biased outlet for rinsing-per-unit-water and fine-mist reduction.
User_Benefit: Defined droplet-size distribution, coverage and reduced fine-mist fraction.
Main_Uncertainty: Independent performance, clogging, pressure loss, noise, spray feel, durability.

Problem_Opportunity: Higher heater temperatures can improve microbial control while increasing scald risk.
DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: Separate microbial-kill temperature from safe delivery temperature.
Proposed_Product_Response: Mixer/thermostatic interface coordinated with upstream state.
User_Benefit: Safe delivery while preserving upstream microbial-control conditions.
Main_Uncertainty: Energy, response time, certification, cost, system-level value.
